The name embodies the communal aspect of prayer and the importance of gathering together as a community for worship. Moreover, it serves as a constant reminder of the spiritual journey that begins at birth and continues throughout one’s life.

The name serves as a constant reminder of the purpose of human existence, which is to worship and serve Allah. It is a call to work on one's faith and character, to seek knowledge, to strive for righteousness, and to be mindful of one's actions. Ultimately, it is a reminder to be in a state of worship at all times, and to strive for closeness to Allah throughout one's life.
